name: R-M11 macro args take no square group
why: Session 325 review round. `\a[x] {\par}`: the macro takes `[x]`, a blank, then `{\par}`; the mutant reads `[x]` as a label and leaves `{\par}` in the open (parent false, mutant true). Needs 7 tokens, so no enumeration reached it: a fixed row of the oracle file.

name: R-M16 optional groups looped once only
why: `\section[a][b]{x}` (parent true, mutant false): only one optional group is read. A fixed row of the oracle file.

name: R-A10 comment prefix shortened to <!-
why: `<!-x <section> -->` (parent true, mutant false). The oracle gained the token `<!-` and a fixed row.

name: R-A12 CDATA prefix drops the bracket
why: `<![CDATAx ] <section> ]]>` (true, mutant false). The oracle gained the token `<![CDATA` and a fixed row.

name: R-A13 CDATA prefix shortened to <![
why: `<![x ] <section> ]]>` (true, mutant false). The oracle gained the token `<![` and a fixed row.

name: R-K09 macro-name letters lower case only
why: `\parX` (parent false, mutant true): a capital ends a macro name. The oracle gained `A`, `\parX` and a fixed row.

name: R-K10 macro-name start lower case only
why: `\Foo{<section>}` (false, mutant true): a macro name may start with a capital.

name: R-K11 star macros not recognised
why: `\section*{x}` (true, mutant false): a star macro of the argument class takes its argument.

name: R-K12 star kept in the name but not skipped
why: `\section*{x}` (true, mutant false): the star is kept in the name but not skipped.

name: R-K13 star skipped but not in the name
why: `\par*` and `\caption*{x}` (false, mutant true): the star is skipped but not in the name.

name: R-K15 script closer case-sensitive
why: `</SCRIPT>` (false, mutant true): the closing script tag is matched without regard to case.

name: R-A31 tag name may start with a digit
why: `<1 title="<section>">` (true, mutant false): a tag name starts with a letter.

name: R-K22 macro name runs on over digits
why: `\par1` (true, mutant false): a macro name ends at a digit.

name: R-H31 a form feed ends a tag name
why: `<section\f>` (false, mutant true): a form feed does not end a tag name.

name: R-H32 a no-break space ends a tag name
why: `<section\u00a0>` (false, mutant true): a no-break space does not end a tag name.

name: R-B07 a second brace follower is consumed
why: `[a](b){<section>}` and `[](){<section>}` (true, mutant false): one follower is consumed after a label, not two. Needs 7 tokens: a fixed row.

name: R-PM2 the table of a [ or { follower is rebuilt
why: The table of the `[` or `{` follower of a label is rebuilt at every ask: same answers, quadratic. `[a]{` x 20,000 took 5.7 s and `[a][` x 20,000 7.1 s under it (HEAD 6 ms). Clock rows `[a]{` and `[a][` (scanned apart from the strips).

name: R-PM3 the braced-arity check rebuilds the [ table
why: The braced-arity check rebuilds the `[` table: `\section[` x 20,000 took 10.9 s under it. Clock row `\section[`.

name: R-PM4 the braced-arity check rebuilds the { table
why: The braced-arity check rebuilds the `{` table: `\section{` x 20,000 took 10.9 s under it. Clock row `\section{`.

name: R-PM8 only the CDATA closer is read from the text
to: const close = marker === "]]>" ? line.text.indexOf(marker, from) : line.indexOfMarker(marker, from);
why: Only the CDATA closer is read from the text, not through `indexOfMarker`: `<![CDATA[` x 200,000 scanned apart from the strips took 3.9 s under it (HEAD 24 ms); at the 12,000 of the document row it costs 20 ms. Clock row of 200,000 CDATA openers.

name: R-A25 letter test lower case only
why: `<SECTION>`: the letter test of a tag name is lower case only. Killed by the OLDER Session 269 rows before the review round; the oracle gained the token `<SECTION>`.

name: R-K14 any-class macros dropped
why: `\maketitle` (true; mutant false): the any-class macros are dropped. Killed by the OLDER Session 269 rows before the review round; the oracle gained the token and a fixed row.
